posts.title: Was March that long ago?
posts.description: I first set this up at the end of March in the middle of a hypomanic state. And I mean TAIL END of March, so maybe we can just say April. April is 04/12 in monthspeak... apparently now it's the end of August so now it's 08/12. I guess if it was the TAIL END of March now it's tail end of August so 8-3=5. Almost half a year has gone by but it feels like an eternity. Like years and years and years. D
